## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:



Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.

```{r}
library(dplyr)
get_mode <- function(x) {
  ux <- unique(x)
  ux[which.max(tabulate(match(x, ux)))]
}
path <- "/Users/ruokun/Desktop/Project/P.3/Rep1"
files <- sprintf("%s/energy_per_iteration_1000_%d.csv", path, 1:5)
summary_list <- lapply(1:5, function(i) {
  df <- read.csv(files[i], header = TRUE)
  data.frame(
    Run = paste0("Run_", i),
    Mean_Energy   = mean(df$energy),
    Median_Energy = median(df$energy),
    SD_Energy     = sd(df$energy),
    Min_Energy    = min(df$energy),
    Max_Energy    = max(df$energy),
    Mode_Energy   = get_mode(df$energy)  )
})
summary_table <- bind_rows(summary_list)
print(summary_table)



```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
mode_list <- list() 
path <- "/Users/ruokun/Desktop/Project/P.3/reps_2/0_predicates"
get_mode <- function(x) {
  ux <- unique(x)
  ux[which.max(tabulate(match(x, ux)))]
}

for (i in 1:5) {
  
file_path <- sprintf("%s/trial_%d/energy_per_iteration_1000.csv", path, i)
  df <- read.csv(file_path, header = TRUE)
  df$iteration <- seq_len(nrow(df))
  mode_energy <- get_mode(df$energy)
  mode_list[[paste0("Run_", i)]] <- mode_energy
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = iteration, y = energy)) +
    geom_line(color = "blue") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = mode_energy, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Energy per Iteration - Run", i),
      x = "Iteration",
      y = "Energy"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
  
  print(p)
  out_file <- sprintf("plot_run_%d.png", i)
  ggsave(out_file, p, width = 8, height = 4, dpi = 300)
}

```
```{r}
plot_func1=function(absolute_path,file,rep=1,model="AQGD"){
  mode_list <- list() 
get_mode <- function(x) {
  ux <- unique(x)
  ux[which.max(tabulate(match(x, ux)))]
}

for (i in 1:5) {
  
file_path <- sprintf(file, absolute_path, i)
  df <- read.csv(file_path, header = TRUE)
  df$iteration <- seq_len(nrow(df))
  mode_energy <- get_mode(df$energy)
  mode_list[[paste0("Run_", i)]] <- mode_energy
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = iteration, y = energy)) +
    geom_line(color = "blue") +
    labs(
      title = paste("Energy per Call back - Run", i),
      x = "Callback count",
      y = "Energy"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
  print(min(df$energy))
  print(p)
  out_file <- file.path(sprintf("/Users/ruokun/Desktop/Project/P.3/Result/%s/Reps_%d",model,rep), sprintf("plot_run_%s_run_rep_%d_%d.png",model,rep, i))
  ggsave(out_file, p, width = 8, height = 4, dpi = 300)
}
}
```






```{r}
plot_func <- function(absolute_path, file, reps=1) {
  mode_list <- list()
  
  get_mode <- function(x) {
    ux <- unique(x)
    ux[which.max(tabulate(match(x, ux)))]
  }
  
  all_df <- list()
  
  for (i in 1:5) {
    file_path <- sprintf(file, absolute_path, i)
    df <- read.csv(file_path, header = TRUE)
    
    df$iteration <- seq_len(nrow(df))
    run_name <- paste0("Run_", i)
    df$Run <- run_name  
    
    mode_energy <- get_mode(df$energy)
    mode_list[[run_name]] <- mode_energy
    
    print(min(df$energy))
    
    all_df[[i]] <- df
  }
  
  df_all <- do.call(rbind, all_df)
  modes_df <- data.frame(
    Run = names(mode_list),
    mode_energy = unlist(mode_list),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  library(ggplot2)
  
  p <- ggplot(df_all, aes(x = iteration, y = energy, color = Run)) +
    geom_line() +
    
    labs(
      title = "Energy per call back",
      x = "Callback count",
      y = "Energy"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
  
  print(p)
  out_file <- file.path("/Users/ruokun/Desktop/Project/P.3", sprintf("plot_all_runs_reps_COBYLA_%s.png", reps))
  ggsave(out_file, p, width = 8, height = 4, dpi = 300)
  
  invisible(mode_list)
}


```
